blocks.text: INDIANAPOLIS— Kevin Durant scored 21 points and Reed Sheppard made six 3-pointers and finished with 20 points as the Houston Rockets beat the Indiana Pacers 119-104 in the NBA on Wednesday night. Sheppard was 6 of 7 from beyond the arc as Houston made 19 3s, but lost center Alperen Sengun late after he was inadvertently hit in the face during a bizarre sequence that included Marcus Smart having words with a fan, who was escorted out of the arena, and Pacers coach Rick Carlisle being ejected after being called for two quick technical fouls all with 7:21 left in the […]...
